method.boundary_scope: indeterminates B.y (B on its constructible line path g: one coordinate free, the other solved from the exact equation of g), H.x and H.y (H, on the non-constructible line j, as a free point of the plane); every other free input is an exact constant at its binary64 value, recorded so that a change of it makes the proof not applicable
method.automatic_scope: boundary rule with no model-specific code: a free point or number becomes indeterminates; a point on a constructible line path, one indeterminate; a point computed outside the class, or on a path that depends on objects outside the class (here H, on j = Line[A, C'] with C' = Rotate[C, 47 degrees, A]), is cut as a free point of the plane, which forgets relations and never invents them; the axes are constants
method.field: rational functions over Q in the indeterminates, extended by at most one square root that is not a perfect square; perfect squares are extracted exactly
method.enclosures: second-order mean-value form of every polynomial: exact rational values of the polynomial and of its gradient at the centre of the box, naive interval enclosures of the second derivatives
method.driver: E_1 replaced by the exact driver point, itself evaluated symbolically and checked identically on the circle path p; for the contact order, by the exact jet of p at that point
method.semantics: ideal ruler-and-compass operations; validity is mathematical (distinct points, nonparallel lines, positive discriminant, positive radius), never an inherited tolerance; selection by the captured inherited selection state
method.sign_conditions: outward-rounded interval evaluation; every decision is taken on the decision box (half-width 1e-9) and recorded; a condition whose interval contains zero is undecided and the result is NOT_ESTABLISHED
method.branches: every line-circle output by the inherited rule with the captured selection state; outside the slice of a replaced driver, the live binary64 output must be certified strictly closer to the selected formal branch than to the other on the whole box, or the result fails closed; continuous-mode intersections and reference-point selections are outside the class
method.rechecks: a proof holds on another box or configuration when the structural signatures of its dependency cone, its constants and the inherited selection states are unchanged, every recorded sign is certified there with the same value and every branch outside the driver slice still corresponds to the live algorithm; no new symbolic work
